snippet.title: MC Frontalot - Common Loot [Playthrough of Interactive Video]
snippet.description:
Featuring @McGwireMusic on the chorus vox and @WheatusOfficial's Brendan B. Brown on guitar.

Why just watch when you can play this interactive music video for yourself? https://frontalot.com/loot

How are you going to feel when IT happens? Front will have certain feelings. And then he's looking forward to being free of certain feelings that many of us are stuck with here, in the now, when IT hasn't quite happened yet. Maybe it'll be soon. Anyway, this is a song about RPG mechanics.

Lyric: MCF
Music: MCF & Gm7
Published by Nerdcore Fervor Conglomerated (ASCAP)

Download available at Front's Bandcamp: https://frontalot.bandcamp.com
From the upcoming album Counterfeit Wine

Seek it on all major streaming platforms, and in the Play & Apple stores, by or before mid-May 2026.
